post.text: Aroha mai, access to our catalogue and eResources will be affected by scheduled maintenance from 8.30pm to midnight tonight. You may be able to browse the catalogue, but you won't be able to login & place holds, or use eResources such as PressReader. my.christchurchcitylibraries.com/news/catalog...

source.agency_name: Christchurch City Libraries (Ngā Kete Wānanga o Ōtautahi)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
